visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) In a bright indoor garage with a high metal ceiling, a man with orange-tinted hair and glasses wearing a black T-shirt and grey paneled trousers leans over the front of an orange sports car. He is looking into the open front trunk while holding a tablet. (2) There is a jump cut and the man is now dressed in a light grey traditional monk-style robe with a large strand of dark brown wooden prayer beads around his neck. He stands in front of the orange car with his hands on his hips, gesturing towards the camera with a confident expression. (3) The scene shifts to the man standing next to a black Toyota Altis. He pulls out a small wooden percussion instrument (a wooden fish) shaped like a cartoon character and taps it near the car's hood. (4) The camera shows a close-up of the black car's interior, featuring black leather seats, a steering wheel with the Toyota logo, and a large central touchscreen display. (5) The man moves to a grey Toyota Altis, performing the same ritual with a different wooden fish toy that has a Capybara face. He taps it multiple times against the hood of the car. (6) A shot reveals a white Toyota Camry in the showroom. The man gestures towards it, then walks around to open the driver-side door. (7) Inside the white Camry, the interior is shown with a brown leather-wrapped steering wheel and black dashboard elements. (8) The man sits on the front bumper of the orange sports car with its butterfly doors open behind him like wings. He has his hands pressed together in a prayer gesture. (9) He then stands next to a white BMW, holding a key fob and gesturing towards the car's front grille. (10) The interior of the white BMW is shown, highlighting the M-sport steering wheel and the gear shifter area.

visual_human_presence.countingEvidence: 1 main male creator appearing throughout the video.
visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: A male with orange-brown dyed hair and glasses, initially wearing a black T-shirt and grey tactical pants, then switching to a light grey monk-style robe with a large wooden bead necklace.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: A large indoor car showroom/garage with multiple used cars parked close together. The walls are corrugated metal, and there are black stairs in the background. Large black banners with white text ('買賣') are visible.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with an upbeat, high-tempo electronic synth track playing as the background music. A male voice asks a question in a curious tone. (2) A transition sound effect 'whoosh' triggers a new phase as the main speaker changes into his monk persona. He speaks with high energy and an exaggerated comedic tone. (3) A sharp percussive 'click' or 'clack' sound occurs every time the speaker taps the wooden fish toy against a car hood. Laughter sound effects are edited in after his jokes. (4) The speaker continues introducing cars with a fast speech rate and rhythmic delivery. Music stays consistent. (5) A different pitch of 'clack' is heard when he uses the second Capybara wooden fish toy. The person off-camera laughs audibly. (6) The music volume ducks slightly during more serious descriptions of car mileage but swells back up for the jokes and price reveals.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Character Setup -> Item 1 (Price) -> Item 2 (Price) -> Item 3 (Price) -> Joke/Twist -> Item 4 (Price) -> Sign-off
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video is a humorous promotional advertisement for a used car dealership. The creator uses a monk persona to 'purify' the cars during the traditional Ghost Month (a time when folk superstition suggests it is unlucky to buy big-ticket items like cars), thereby encouraging viewers to buy used vehicles from his shop with confidence and humor.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The entire video is set in a car showroom, features the logo 'ATDC Atzu Dream Car', and explicitly lists prices for several used vehicles.

high_inference.freeDescribe: High-energy sales content disguised as a comedic short form video. The use of folk religious themes as a marketing angle is notable for its cultural specificity.
